src/lib/components/ReactGridLayout.react.description:
Dash wrapper around `react-grid-layout`. Supply a `layout` array describing
each item's width, height and position, and pass Dash components as children
whose `id` matches the corresponding layout item's `i` value. Dragging or
resizing items emits the updated `layout`, enabling interactive grid editors.

id.description: The ID used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

layout.description: Layout configuration for the grid. Each entry must include `i`, `x`, `y`, `w`, `h`.

children.description:
Dash components to render inside the grid. Each child should have an `id`
that matches the corresponding layout item's `i` value.

cols.description: Number of columns in the grid or per breakpoint when using responsive layouts.

rowHeight.description: Height of a single row in pixels.

margin.description: Margin between items `[x, y]` in pixels.

containerPadding.description: Padding inside the container `[x, y]` in pixels.

compactType.description: Compact items vertically, horizontally, or disable compaction.

preventCollision.description: Prevent items from overlapping when moved.

autoSize.description: Automatically adjust height of container to fit rows.

allowOverlap.description: Allow items to overlap when dragging.

draggableHandle.description: Selector string the user can drag within via handles.

draggableCancel.description: Selector string preventing elements from being dragged from within.

breakpoints.description: Breakpoint definitions when using responsive layouts.

layouts.description: Layouts per breakpoint when using responsive mode.

setProps.description: Dash-assigned callback to report property changes back to Dash.

onLayoutChange.description: Callback invoked when the layout changes on drag, drop, or resize.

className.description: CSS class applied to the grid container.

style.description: Inline styles applied to the grid container.
